items.summary: Conny Glenn, who who served as a councillor for Sydenham District for the past four years, ended Bryan Paterson's bid for a fourth-consecutive term as mayor of Kingston, Ont.

items.title: Shaun Chen wins Scarborough North as rookie incumbent defeated by former Liberal MP
items.summary: The battle for Scarborough North, saw Jamaal Myers, the incumbent, lose his seat against Chen, who was one of two political veterans, who entered the municipal race in a bid to oust the rookie councillor.
